spec.description: Results of Queries 1, 2 and 3 on flight analysis: monthly performance AA vs DL, arrival delay ranking, hourly percentiles by carrier.

spec.title: Q1 — Average Monthly Departure Delay: AA vs DL
spec.description: Monthly comparison of average departure delay (minutes) between American Airlines (AA) and Delta Air Lines (DL). Only non-cancelled flights.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
  to_char(make_date(2025, month, 1), 'Mon') AS month_label,
  MAX(CASE WHEN carrier = 'AA' THEN ROUND(avg_delay::numeric, 1) END) AS "AA (American Airlines)",
  MAX(CASE WHEN carrier = 'DL' THEN ROUND(avg_delay::numeric, 1) END) AS "DL (Delta Air Lines)"
FROM monthly_performance_rdd
GROUP BY month
ORDER BY month

spec.title: Q4 — Airline Assignments (Sorted by Cluster)
spec.description: Full airline data and predictions, ordered for easy comparison.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
  "OP_UNIQUE_CARRIER" AS carrier,
  prediction AS cluster,
  ROUND(avg_dep_delay::numeric, 2) AS dep_delay,
  ROUND(avg_arr_delay::numeric, 2) AS arr_delay,
  ROUND((cancellation_rate * 100)::numeric, 2) AS cancel_rate_pct,
  ROUND(avg_carrier_delay::numeric, 2) AS carrier_d,
  ROUND(avg_weather_delay::numeric, 2) AS weather_d,
  ROUND(avg_nas_delay::numeric, 2) AS nas_d,
  ROUND(avg_security_delay::numeric, 2) AS security_d,
  ROUND(avg_late_aircraft_delay::numeric, 2) AS late_ac_d
FROM airline_clustering_dataframe_1
ORDER BY prediction, carrier
SELECT CONCAT('Cluster ', prediction), count(*) as Airlines FROM airline_clustering_dataframe_1 GROUP BY prediction;

spec.title: Q1 — Monthly Cancellation Rate: AA vs DL
spec.description: Monthly percentage of cancelled flights out of total observed flights for AA and DL. Calculated on all flights (cancelled + non-cancelled).

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
  to_char(make_date(2025, month, 1), 'Mon') AS month_label,
  MAX(CASE WHEN carrier = 'AA' THEN ROUND(cancellation_rate::numeric, 2) END) AS "AA (American Airlines)",
  MAX(CASE WHEN carrier = 'DL' THEN ROUND(cancellation_rate::numeric, 2) END) AS "DL (Delta Air Lines)"
FROM monthly_performance_rdd
GROUP BY month
ORDER BY month

spec.title: Q2 — Top 10 Airlines by Average Arrival Delay
spec.description: Ranking of the 10 airlines with the highest average arrival delay (minutes). Only non-cancelled and non-diverted flights with at least 500 valid flights.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT carrier, ROUND(avg_arr_delay::numeric, 2) AS avg_arr_delay
FROM arrival_delay_ranking_rdd
ORDER BY avg_arr_delay DESC
LIMIT 10

spec.title: Q2 — Average Contribution of Delay Causes by Airline
spec.description: Percentage breakdown of delay causes for the top 10 airlines. Missing component values are treated as 0.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
  carrier,
  ROUND(avg_carrier_delay::numeric, 2) AS "Carrier",
  ROUND(avg_weather_delay::numeric, 2) AS "Weather",
  ROUND(avg_nas_delay::numeric, 2) AS "NAS",
  ROUND(avg_security_delay::numeric, 2) AS "Security",
  ROUND(avg_late_aircraft_delay::numeric, 2) AS "Late Aircraft"
FROM arrival_delay_ranking_rdd
ORDER BY avg_arr_delay DESC
LIMIT 10

spec.title: Q3 — Departure Delay Percentiles by Hour of Day ($TargetCarrier)
spec.description: Hourly distribution of departure delay (p25, p50, p75, p90) for selected airlines. Only non-cancelled flights.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
  LPAD(hour::text, 2, '0') || ':00' AS hour_label,
  MAX(CASE WHEN "opUniqueCarrier" = 'AA' THEN ROUND(p25::numeric,1) END) AS "AA p25",
  MAX(CASE WHEN "opUniqueCarrier" = 'AA' THEN ROUND(p50::numeric,1) END) AS "AA p50",
  MAX(CASE WHEN "opUniqueCarrier" = 'AA' THEN ROUND(p75::numeric,1) END) AS "AA p75",
  MAX(CASE WHEN "opUniqueCarrier" = 'AA' THEN ROUND(p90::numeric,1) END) AS "AA p90",
  MAX(CASE WHEN "opUniqueCarrier" = 'DL' THEN ROUND(p25::numeric,1) END) AS "DL p25",
  MAX(CASE WHEN "opUniqueCarrier" = 'DL' THEN ROUND(p50::numeric,1) END) AS "DL p50",
  MAX(CASE WHEN "opUniqueCarrier" = 'DL' THEN ROUND(p75::numeric,1) END) AS "DL p75",
  MAX(CASE WHEN "opUniqueCarrier" = 'DL' THEN ROUND(p90::numeric,1) END) AS "DL p90",
  MAX(CASE WHEN "opUniqueCarrier" = 'UA' THEN ROUND(p25::numeric,1) END) AS "UA p25",
  MAX(CASE WHEN "opUniqueCarrier" = 'UA' THEN ROUND(p50::numeric,1) END) AS "UA p50",
  MAX(CASE WHEN "opUniqueCarrier" = 'UA' THEN ROUND(p75::numeric,1) END) AS "UA p75",
  MAX(CASE WHEN "opUniqueCarrier" = 'UA' THEN ROUND(p90::numeric,1) END) AS "UA p90",
  MAX(CASE WHEN "opUniqueCarrier" = 'WN' THEN ROUND(p25::numeric,1) END) AS "WN p25",
  MAX(CASE WHEN "opUniqueCarrier" = 'WN' THEN ROUND(p50::numeric,1) END) AS "WN p50",
  MAX(CASE WHEN "opUniqueCarrier" = 'WN' THEN ROUND(p75::numeric,1) END) AS "WN p75",
  MAX(CASE WHEN "opUniqueCarrier" = 'WN' THEN ROUND(p90::numeric,1) END) AS "WN p90"
FROM hourly_delay_percentiles_rdd_kll_1
WHERE "opUniqueCarrier" IN ($TargetCarrier)
GROUP BY hour
ORDER BY hour

spec.title: Q3 — Departure Delay Median Heatmap by Hour and Carrier ($TargetCarrier)
spec.description: Median (p50) departure delay by hour of day and airline. Darker colors indicate higher delays.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
  LPAD(hour::text, 2, '0') || ':00' AS hour_label,
  MAX(CASE WHEN "opUniqueCarrier" = 'AA' THEN ROUND(p50::numeric,1) END) AS "AA",
  MAX(CASE WHEN "opUniqueCarrier" = 'DL' THEN ROUND(p50::numeric,1) END) AS "DL",
  MAX(CASE WHEN "opUniqueCarrier" = 'UA' THEN ROUND(p50::numeric,1) END) AS "UA",
  MAX(CASE WHEN "opUniqueCarrier" = 'WN' THEN ROUND(p50::numeric,1) END) AS "WN"
FROM hourly_delay_percentiles_rdd_kll_1
WHERE "opUniqueCarrier" IN ($TargetCarrier)
GROUP BY hour
ORDER BY hour

spec.title: Q3 — Global Min/Max Delay by Carrier ($TargetCarrier)
spec.description: Absolute minimum and maximum departure delay across the entire dataset for each selected airline.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT "opUniqueCarrier", min_delay_global, max_delay_global
FROM hourly_delay_percentiles_rdd_kll_2
WHERE "opUniqueCarrier" IN ($TargetCarrier)
ORDER BY "opUniqueCarrier"

spec.title: Q4 — Airline Clustering Distribution (8D Logic, 2D PCA Projection)
spec.description: True projection of 8D clusters. Small dots = Airlines, Large dots = Centers. All grouped by Cluster ID.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
  "OP_UNIQUE_CARRIER" as carrier,
  pca_x,
  pca_y,
  prediction AS cluster,
  'Airline' AS type
FROM airline_clustering_dataframe_1
UNION ALL
SELECT
  'center' as carrier,
  pca_x,
  pca_y,
  cluster,
  'Center' AS type
FROM airline_clustering_dataframe_2

spec.title: Q4 — Cluster Center Profiles (8D Averages)
spec.description: Shows the average values of all 8 features that determined the cluster centers.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
  'Cluster ' || cluster::text AS cluster_label,
  ROUND(avg_dep_delay_center::numeric, 2) AS "Dep Delay",
  ROUND(avg_arr_delay_center::numeric, 2) AS "Arr Delay",
  ROUND(cancellation_rate_center::numeric, 2) AS "Cancel Rate",
  ROUND(avg_carrier_delay_center::numeric, 2) AS "Carrier D.",
  ROUND(avg_weather_delay_center::numeric, 2) AS "Weather D.",
  ROUND(avg_nas_delay_center::numeric, 2) AS "NAS D.",
  ROUND(avg_security_delay_center::numeric, 2) AS "Security D.",
  ROUND(avg_late_aircraft_delay_center::numeric, 2) AS "Late Ac. D."
FROM airline_clustering_dataframe_2
ORDER BY cluster
